children: Frontage proposed privatization from HKEX and subsequent asset restructuring, with businesses expected to be divided among Charles River Laboratories, Tigermed and Chairman Dr. Song Li. The transaction requires shareholder and regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions.
Would take Frontage private, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals; no transaction value or consideration is stated here.
Exton bioanalysis and DMPK expected to go to Charles River
Transfers the Pennsylvania-based business to a strategic buyer if the restructuring closes.
PRC business expected to go to Tigermed
Would transfer Frontage's PRC business and the Acme Bioscience business to Tigermed.
Remaining non-PRC business expected to go to Dr. Song Li
Would place the remaining operations, including non-Exton bioanalysis and DMPK, with Frontage's chairman.
Transaction awaits shareholder and regulatory approvals
Closing remains uncertain; the release provides no expected timetable or financial terms.
